title: MPCI-Bench: A Benchmark for Multimodal Pairwise Contextual Integrity Evaluation of Language Model Agents
reasoning: The paper introduces and evaluates a benchmark based on Contextual Integrity (CI), which is a framework for assessing the appropriateness of information flows according to social norms. Evaluating whether an agent respects or violates privacy norms is a core component of evaluating ethical behavior and adherence to social/moral standards in AI agents.
